title: Off-Policy Evaluation for Semantic ID Recommenders: Does the Model's Own Code Hierarchy Help?
abstract: arXiv:2608.28905v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Generative recommenders increasingly emit semantic IDs (SIDs): each item is a short sequence of hierarchical discrete codes from a residual quantizer, decoded autoregressively. Before spending scarce A/B-test, a team may decide offline which decoder or reranking variants are worth testing - a job for off-policy evaluation (OPE). We ask a simple question: can the model's own SID tree serve as the action abstraction for that OPE? Our answer has three parts. (i) Under the near-argmax logging real recommenders use, per-item OPE is hopeless - as item-level effective sample size is usually small on production logs - but marginalizing items to code-prefix clusters restores estimable support and cuts error. (ii) This gain is thanks to coarsening, not to the hierarchy specifically; but the SID tree is what makes coarsening feasible in a generative system - each cluster's mass is exactly and cheaply returned by the decoder, whereas flat clustering

translated_title: 语义ID推荐器的离线策略评估：模型自身的编码层级是否有帮助？
translated_abstract: 生成式推荐系统越来越多地输出语义ID（SID）：每个物品被表示为由残差量化器产生的层级离散编码组成的短序列，并通过自回归方式解码。在投入稀缺的A/B测试资源之前，团队可能需要在离线状态下决定哪些解码器或重排序变体值得测试——这正是离线策略评估（OPE）的任务。我们提出一个简单的问题：模型自身的SID树能否作为该OPE的动作抽象？我们的答案包含三个部分。（i）在真实推荐系统所使用的近argmax日志策略下，逐物品的OPE是无望的——因为生产日志中物品级的有效样本量通常很小——但将物品边缘化到编码前缀聚类可以恢复可估计的支持并减少误差。（ii）这一收益源于粗化本身，而非层级结构；但SID树正是使粗化在生成式系统中可行的关键——每个聚类的质量可由解码器精确且廉价地返回，而平坦聚类……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究发现，离线策略评估的误差降低来自将物品粗化为编码前缀聚类而非层级结构本身，但生成式推荐器的语义ID树恰好使这种粗化变得可行且计算高效。
en_tdlr: While the error reduction in off-policy evaluation comes from coarsening items into code-prefix clusters rather than the hierarchy per se, the generative recommender's semantic ID tree is precisely what makes such coarsening feasible and computationally efficient.
